one_liner: Chooses the recording codec: RAW, ProRes, or compressed H.265/H.264.
what_it_does: Sets codec, bit depth and container for video. RAW (N-RAW, ProRes RAW) keeps sensor data for maximum grading latitude with huge files; ProRes 422 HQ is an edit-friendly 10-bit intermediate; H.265 10-bit is the efficient choice for Log/HLG; H.265 8-bit and H.264 8-bit are SDR-only for small, easy files. On the Z50II, tone mode is picked by highlighting the 10-bit file type and pressing right.

options.meaning: Nikon RAW video; Z8 and Z5II.
options.use_when: Maximum grading latitude - but needs DaVinci Resolve, not Final Cut Pro.
RAW video that edits natively in Final Cut Pro.
Final Cut Pro editing with minimal transcoding; big files.
Default for N-Log/HLG and long bird sessions.
Family clips.

options.meaning: SDR only, most compatible, AAC audio.
options.use_when: Quick sharing; Z50II slow-motion modes use it.

when_to_change: Choose per project: H.265 10-bit for most work; ProRes RAW/422 HQ on Z8 when grading matters and cards allow.

suggested.value: Z8: H.265 10-bit N-Log 4K (or ProRes RAW HQ for hero shots, FCP-native)
Z8: H.265 10-bit SDR or N-Log; Z5II: H.265 10-bit
H.265 8-bit or H.264 8-bit SDR
H.265 10-bit N-Log or HLG

body_differences: Z8: N-RAW 12-bit, ProRes RAW HQ 12-bit, ProRes 422 HQ 10-bit, H.265 10/8-bit, H.264 8-bit. Z5II: N-RAW 12-bit, H.265 10/8-bit, H.264 8-bit (no ProRes; N-RAW at 4032x2268 FX / 3984x2240 DX up to 30p). Z50II: H.265 10/8-bit and H.264 8-bit only.
gotchas: Final Cut Pro does not import N-RAW; use ProRes RAW on the Z8, or DaVinci Resolve for N-RAW (general knowledge - verify on your FCP version).
8-bit options lock tone mode to SDR - N-Log and HLG need a 10-bit (or RAW) file type.
RAW and ProRes files fill cards very fast; Z5II/Z50II record to SD.
firmware_note: Z8 fw 3.00: ProRes 422 HQ metadata now includes make/model.

one_liner: SDR looks finished; N-Log keeps range for grading; HLG is HDR-ready.
what_it_does: SDR (BT.709) bakes in the Picture Control look. N-Log (BT.2020) records a flat logarithmic curve that keeps highlight and shadow range for grading with a LUT in Final Cut Pro. HLG (BT.2100) is an HDR delivery format for HDR TVs/phones. Log and HLG raise the minimum ISO.

options.meaning: Flat log needing a LUT/grade. ISO floor 800 on Z5II/Z50II (Lo values also offered); Z8 gained low-ISO N-Log options in fw 2.00.

SDR

8-bit file types force SDR.

name: Shutter speed in video (180° rule), shutter angle and ND

menu_path.z8: Mode M in video; Custom settings g13 Shutter mode (speed or angle, fw 2.10+); g12 Extended shutter speeds (mode M)
menu_path.z5ii: Mode M (or S) in video; Custom settings g10 Extended shutter speeds (S/M)

one_liner: Keep shutter near 1/(2 x fps) for natural motion; ND in bright light.
what_it_does: Video shutter speed sets motion blur per frame. The 180° convention (about double the frame rate: 1/50 at 24/25p, 1/60 at 30p, 1/125 at 60p) gives natural motion. With shutter and aperture fixed, a variable ND controls exposure in daylight. The Z8 can express shutter as an angle so it stays at 180° when you change frame rate.

options.use_when: Most video, stage, family.
Bird video you'll pull frames from.

options.meaning: Shutter set as angle, preserved across frame-rate changes.
options.use_when: Switching between 24p and 120p for birds.

when_to_change: Set once per frame rate; change only for creative blur or to freeze wing beats.

suggested.value: 4K 60p at 1/125 (or 180° angle) with variable ND; 1/250–1/500 for crisp wings
1/50 at 25p or 1/60 at 30p; match mains frequency to avoid LED flicker

body_differences: Only the Z8 has Shutter mode (shutter angle), added in fw 2.10. Extended shutter speeds in video: Z8 g12 (mode M); Z5II/Z50II g10 (S/M).
gotchas: Under LED/stage lighting, speeds not matched to the mains frequency can flicker - use Video flicker reduction or match it.
No built-in ND on these bodies - carry a variable ND for daylight 180° work.
firmware_note: Z8 fw 2.10 added g13 Shutter mode (shutter angle 5.6°–360°).

name: Microphone sensitivity
one_liner: Sets recording level for built-in or external mic: Auto, Manual 1–20, or off.

name: Shooting menu banks and Custom settings banks (Z8)

menu_path.z8: Photo shooting menu > Shooting menu bank (A–D) and Extended menu banks; Video recording menu > Shooting menu bank / Extended menu banks; Custom settings menu > Custom settings bank (A–D)

one_liner: Four switchable menu sets on the Z8 for different genres.
what_it_does: The Z8 stores four photo shooting menu banks and four Custom settings banks (A–D); switching a bank swaps a whole set of values, e.g. A = birds, B = stage, C = landscape. Extended menu banks makes photo banks also store exposure mode and exposure values. Banks are not memories: any change is written into the active bank immediately.

options.use_when: One bank per genre.

options.meaning: ON adds exposure mode, shutter, aperture and related values to the bank.
options.use_when: ON if each genre has its own exposure mode.
Genre-specific button layouts.

when_to_change: Switch bank when the genre changes; rename banks (e.g. BIRD, STAGE) to avoid confusion.

suggested.value: Bank A: M + Auto ISO, HE* RAW, Matrix
Bank B: Highlight-weighted, silent drive, Neutral PC
Bank C: Lossless RAW, base ISO, Auto ISO off
Bank C or D with Warm display colors Mode 2

body_differences: Z8 only. Z5II and Z50II use U1–U3 user settings on the mode dial instead.
gotchas: Any tweak overwrites the bank's stored value - there is no 'revert to saved'.
Photo menu bank and Custom settings bank are chosen separately - check both.
firmware_note: Z8 fw 2.10: photo and video shooting modes can be selected separately (banks reset to P after that update).
research_notes: Bank contents and Extended menu banks behaviour summarised from Nikon's menu naming and long-standing Nikon bank behaviour; Z8 page text not machine-readable. Whether the photo and video shooting menu banks are linked was not verified.

name: User settings U1–U3 (mode dial)

menu_path.z5ii: Setup menu > Save user settings > Save to U1/U2/U3; Setup menu > Reset user settings
menu_path.z50ii: Setup menu > Save user settings > Save to U1/U2/U3; Setup menu > Reset user settings

one_liner: Saves a complete camera setup to U1–U3 on the mode dial.
what_it_does: Saves current photo, video and Custom settings plus shooting mode, shutter, aperture and exposure compensation to a mode-dial position. Turning the dial to U1–U3 recalls that snapshot; unlike Z8 banks, changes made while in U mode are not kept unless you save again.

options.use_when: e.g. U1 stage, U2 birds, U3 landscape.

options.meaning: Returns a U position to defaults (P mode).
options.use_when: Starting a slot over.

when_to_change: Re-save after you refine a setup in the field.

suggested.value: U1: M + Auto ISO, 1/500, Highlight-weighted, silent shutter
U2: A + Auto ISO, Auto WB 0, RAW + JPEG fine
U3: A, base ISO, Auto ISO off, Lossless

body_differences: Z5II and Z50II only. Z8 uses shooting menu banks/Custom settings banks and Recall shooting functions instead.
gotchas: Not saved: storage folder, Manage Picture Control, multiple exposure, interval timer, time-lapse, focus shift (Z50II manual).
Loading menu settings from a card overwrites U1–U3.
firmware_note: Z50II fw 1.10 and Z5II fw 1.20 added a 'Save focus position > On saving user settings' option.
research_notes: Saved/not-saved lists read from Z50II manual; Z5II assumed equivalent.

name: Recall shooting functions (Z8)

menu_path.z8: Custom settings menu > f2 Custom controls (shooting) > choose a button > Recall shooting functions (press) or Recall shooting functions (hold) - role names not re-read in this pass

one_liner: One button instantly swaps to a stored alternate setup, e.g. bird-in-flight.
what_it_does: Stores an alternate set of shooting values (such as exposure mode, shutter speed, AF-area mode, subject detection, metering) on a button. Pressing or holding that button temporarily switches to them - e.g. from perched-bird settings to flight settings - and releasing/pressing again returns. Since fw 2.00 you can adjust white balance and exposure compensation while the recall is active.

options.use_when: Quick flight burst, then back.
Longer stretches in the alternate setup.

when_to_change: Set it up once per genre bank; it's a faster alternative to switching banks.

suggested.value: Hold-button recall: 1/3200 s, Wide-area C1 + bird detection, CH 20 fps
Recall to faster shutter (1/1000) for jumps/turns

body_differences: Z8 only among the three; Z50II's f2 role list has no such role; Z5II not verified (assumed absent).
gotchas: Recall values are stored per Custom settings bank.
Forgetting a toggled recall leaves you on the alternate setup.
firmware_note: Z8 fw 2.00: white balance and exposure compensation adjustable while recalling.
research_notes: Exact role names and the list of recallable items were not read from the Z8 manual (page body not machine-readable). Existence confirmed by Nikon's fw 2.00 note. Per-bank storage is assumed from Custom settings bank design.

name: Save/load menu settings
one_liner: Back up your whole camera setup to a card and restore it later.
what_it_does: Writes most menu settings (photo, video, all Custom settings, selected playback/setup items, My Menu, U1–U3) to an NCSET file on the memory card, and loads them back. Use it as a backup before firmware updates or resets; files only load into the same camera model.

options.use_when: After setting up; before firmware updates.

options.meaning: Restores from card (appears only if a file is present).
options.use_when: After a reset or on a second body of the same model.

when_to_change: Save after any setup session; keep a copy on your computer.

suggested.value: Save after building the bird bank; copy NCSET file to the Mac

body_differences: All three. Settings cannot cross models (Z8 file won't load on Z5II). Z8 fw 2.00: NX MobileAir can also transfer saved menu settings.
gotchas: Renaming the NCSET file stops it loading.
Custom Picture Controls are saved as Auto; monitor brightness and storage folder aren't saved (Z50II).
Loading overwrites U1–U3 (Z5II/Z50II).
firmware_note: Z8 fw 2.00: NX MobileAir can transfer saved menu settings to/from the camera.
research_notes: Save/exclusion lists read from Z50II page.

name: Monitor/EVF brightness and monitor modes

menu_path.z8: Setup menu > Monitor brightness / Viewfinder brightness / Monitor & Viewfinder color balance / Viewfinder display size / Limit monitor mode selection; monitor mode button cycles modes
menu_path.z5ii: Setup menu > Monitor brightness / Viewfinder brightness / color balance / Viewfinder display size / Limit monitor mode selection / Automatic monitor display switch (fw 1.20)
menu_path.z50ii: Setup menu > Monitor brightness / Viewfinder brightness / color balance / Viewfinder display size / Limit monitor mode selection / Automatic monitor display switch (fw 1.10); REC lamp brightness

one_liner: Display brightness only affects viewing - judge exposure by histogram, not screen.
what_it_does: Sets how bright the rear monitor and EVF look, their color balance and EVF image size. Monitor modes (automatic eye-sensor switching, viewfinder only, monitor only, etc.) are cycled with the monitor mode button and can be limited. None of this changes the recorded image, but a too-bright screen at night makes images look brighter than they are.

options.meaning: Display brightness only; higher drains battery more.
options.use_when: Lower at night/stage; higher in sun.

options.meaning: Smaller EVF image for eyeglass wearers.
options.use_when: If you can't see the corners with glasses.

options.meaning: Removes modes from the monitor-mode button cycle.
options.use_when: Prevent accidental EVF-only/monitor-only.

when_to_change: Dim for night/stage; brighten in bright sun; then trust the histogram.

suggested.value: Monitor dimmed, EVF use, 'Viewfinder only' mode to avoid lighting up the audience
Low brightness + Warm display colors
Monitor brightness higher outdoors; check waveform not screen

body_differences: Z5II (fw 1.20) and Z50II (fw 1.10) added an 'Automatic monitor display switch' setup item. Z50II has a REC lamp brightness item. Z8 fw 2.00 extended Viewfinder display size to video and playback.
gotchas: Monitor brightness can only be changed while the monitor is the active display (Z50II).
In HLG, raising monitor brightness changes the displayed tone distribution and reduces highlight fidelity (Z50II).
firmware_note: Z8 fw 2.00: viewfinder display size applies to video and playback. Z50II fw 1.10 / Z5II fw 1.20: Automatic monitor display switch.
research_notes: Monitor mode names and EVF brightness ranges not read in this pass.
